title: Stars, Stripes, and Silicon: Unravelling the ChatGPT’s All-American, Monochrome, Cis-centric Bias

bias_targets.methodology: Literature review and conceptual analysis of training datasets primarily comprising American English data, assessing how this restricts the diversity of perspectives and linguistic knowledge in language models.
Literature synthesis analyzing the ingestion of massive, unfiltered internet corpora (such as CommonCrawl and The Pile) and the subsequent propagation of racist and toxic content in model outputs.
Examining dataset authorship demographics, such as the severe underrepresentation of female contributors on Wikipedia, and reviewing the presence of sexist content in uncurated pre-training data.

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and Gender Identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing instances and vulnerabilities (like prompt injection storytelling) where models generate offensive content targeting LGBTQIA+ individuals and minority groups with minimal or no prompting.
